gaps.title: Missing OIDC ID Token validation
gaps.jtbd: When using OIDC for SSO, I want the system to validate the ID token signature locally, so that I don't have to rely on an unnecessary OAuth2 userinfo roundtrip.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an OIDC login request, When the OIDC token is provided, Then the system verifies the JWT signature and extracts claims directly instead of using it as an opaque access token for the userinfo endpoint.
gaps.reason: The brief explicitly requests OIDC integration ('OAuth2 / OIDC / LTI'), but the implemented fetchOidcProfile simply forwards the token to the OAuth2 userinfo endpoint, treating it as an opaque access token instead of a true OIDC JWT.

gaps.title: Missing OAuth2 State Parameter Validation
gaps.jtbd: When completing an OAuth2 login, I want the system to validate the state parameter against the one issued during the authorization request, so that I am protected against CSRF attacks.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an OAuth2 callback request, When the state parameter is provided, Then the system validates it against the stored session/cookie state and rejects the request if they do not match or if the state is missing.
gaps.reason: This is a domain-standard expectation for any OAuth2 implementation. Although the MoodleCallbackRequest accepts a state parameter, it is completely ignored in the moodleCallback logic.
